return m.group(1) if m else None def report(tag,url,html): m=re.search(r'(.*?)',html); print(tag,"URL:",url,"TITLE:",m.group(1) if m else '?') for e in re.findall(r'qisutu-install-error[^>]*>(.*?)',html,re.S): print(" ERROR:",re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',e).strip()) return html url,html=get(); report("step4",url,html) url,html=post({"Step":"4","Action":"SaveSystem","CSRFToken":csrf(html),"HTTPType":"http","FQDN":"localhost","WebPath":"/qisutu","AdminEmail":"admin@example.org","DefaultLanguage":"de","Timezone":"Europe/Berlin","TicketHook":"Qisutu","AttachmentMaxSize":"25"}); report("savesys",url,html) url,html=get(BASE+"?Step=5"); report("step5",url,html) url,html=post({"Step":"5","Action":"SkipMail","CSRFToken":csrf(html)}); report("skipmail",url,html) url,html=get(BASE+"?Step=6"); open('/tmp/final.html','w').write(html); report("final",url,html) PY python3 /tmp/full.py
